name: MarqueDeLago

seo.title: MarqueDeLago — A Lakeside Penthouse in Bucharest | Jet Crust
seo.description: MarqueDeLago is a 500 sqm duplex penthouse above a Bucharest lake. Pininfarina master suite, Miele kitchen, Bowers & Wilkins sound, two heated terraces with a lake-view jacuzzi. Sleeps 8.

tagline: A 500 square metre duplex penthouse above a Bucharest lake, wrapped in glass, finished by the names you would hope for, and just as considered as Castelaria.
story_heading: Mornings on the water, evenings over the city
story: MarqueDeLago sits at the top of Emerald Residences, high above a Bucharest lake, arranged as a duplex across two floors and wrapped almost entirely in glass. Light arrives in the morning across the water and settles into the city by night.

The master suite was shaped by Pininfarina. The kitchen runs on Miele, the sound is Bowers and Wilkins, and the whole penthouse answers to a single smart home system. Two terraces with heated floors stay open through winter, one facing the lake with a jacuzzi beneath a retractable pergola, the other a summer kitchen made for long dinners in the open air.
It is the modern counterpoint to Castelaria, for a different kind of escape and the same standard of care.

features.title: The Lake Terrace
features.text: A heated terrace over the water, with a jacuzzi under a retractable pergola and the whole lake for a view.

features.title: A Pininfarina Suite
features.text: A master bedroom designed by Pininfarina, with sunrise over the lake and a walk-in closet the size of a room.

features.title: The Miele Kitchen
features.text: A full Miele suite in black gloss and Italian marble, with a summer kitchen in stainless on the terrace.

features.title: Living Above the City
features.text: Open-plan living behind floor-to-ceiling glass, Bowers and Wilkins throughout, the city laid out below.

setting.heading: Lakefront, minutes from the city
setting.lead: MarqueDeLago crowns Emerald Residences on the edge of a Bucharest lake, secure behind card-access lifts and round-the-clock security, yet a short drive from the centre and the airport.

addons.title: In-Home Spa

addons.text: A private concierge for Bucharest, from tables to tickets to after hours.

addons.title: Airport & Driver
addons.text: A car and driver on call, from the moment you land to the day you leave.

card.desc: A refined penthouse above the water, where floor to ceiling glass frames the lake and the city softens into evening. Modern calm, minutes from the heart of Bucharest.
